title: A fast Laguerre--Fourier spectral method for the polyatomic Boltzmann collision operator with continuous internal energ
summary: The polyatomic Boltzmann equation extends the classical kinetic description to gases whose molecules possess internal energy in addition to their translational motion. The distribution function then has one more variable than in the monatomic case, and the collision operator becomes an eight-fold integral whose evaluation dominates the cost of solving the equation. In this work, we propose a fast Laguerre--Fourier spectral method for the polyatomic Boltzmann equation with continuous internal energy, which evaluates the collision operator in $O(K^2MN^4\log N + K^3MN^4)$ online operations…
